name: Kadoya 100% Pure Toasted Sesame Oil
whyItWorks: Intensely aromatic oil pressed from toasted sesame seeds. Contains 0g of fiber and 0g of alliums, yet just a few drops impart massive Asian stir-fry and noodle flavor to plain rice and poached chicken.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Drizzle 1/2 teaspoon over warm steamed white rice, pho broth, somen noodles, or steamed baby bok choy just before serving.
